title: Player Installed Support / Auxiliary Component Reference-Swept Catalog

foundation.supportComponentKissRule: An optional support/AUX component belongs only when it materially changes what the player can do, what risk they face, or how efficiently they perform an existing gameplay activity.
foundation.cp138CombatExecutionBoundary: Only already-executable ECM/ECCM, PDS families, and Shield Hardener enter the primary full-ship combat sweep; campaign/TBD AUX are covered architecturally and power-supply/storage AUX are held for the later Reactor phase.

notes: This catalog supersedes the CP43-era separate Auxiliary Capacity candidate catalog as design authority; the exact v0_1 file remains at its legacy path for frozen runtime/calibration consumers.
Exact footprints/effects remain TBD unless explicitly established elsewhere or resolved by CP108 (Ablative Armor = 1 Space).
PDS and other installed defensive components may appear here for construction/support visibility even when their technology lineage is a standard combat family.

CP108 adds the previously preserved Probe / Survey Drone Package and materializes the two Storyboard Shield-support candidates omitted by v0.2; the overlapping Armor EM-particle-screen component is consolidated rather than duplicated.
CP138 maps all 35 catalog components to reference philosophies and evidence. Coverage does not imply numerical promotion or combat execution.
ECM/ECCM are integrated standard AUX-slot systems for CP138 full-ship testing but remain owned by their Sensors/EW lineages rather than duplicated as catalog components.

supersededOrConsolidatedComponents.reason: Avoid duplicate charged-particle specialist screens in Armor and Shields; radiation/material hardening remains the distinct Armor response.

cp138ShieldAuxVetting.shield-battery: Legacy restore-3 pre-x2 seed would map to 6 current points and can recreate the full-reset shield pathology; reject legacy numeric carry-forward and rederive later.
cp138ShieldAuxVetting.shield-booster: Legacy +2 SC pre-x2 seed would map to +4 current SC and is too large to carry blindly; rederive later.
cp138ShieldAuxVetting.shield-hardener: Retain current executable 1 Space / 1 TP sustained / SA2 nonstacking candidate for integration testing; it changes hardening, not recharge.
cp138ShieldAuxVetting.particle-deflection-screen: Defer numerical combat execution until a tagged particle/charged-beam threat exists; do not fake a universal effect.
cp138ShieldAuxVetting.field-stabilizer: Defer numerical combat execution; current candidate overlaps Shield Hardener and needs a specific high-SPEN specialist lane.
